title: Correct height calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute the correct height using free-fall displacement formula with given time.

title: Correct final velocity
description: Essential: Student must compute the correct magnitude of velocity upon impact using appropriate kinematic relation.

title: Use of correct kinematic equations
description: Important: Student must apply displacement and velocity formulas for constant acceleration from rest.

title: Proper value for g
description: Important: Student must use g = 9.8 m/s² (or consistent value) in calculations.

title: Units in final answers
description: Optional: Student should include correct units (m and m/s) with numerical answers.

title: Sign confusion in velocity
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses sign or direction for velocity magnitude, or confuses speed with velocity vector.

title: Using wrong time or formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses t=5s incorrectly (e.g., in v=gt/2) or applies non-free-fall formulas.
